 Deals Yes, Lululemon Dropped Its Black Friday Sale Early — Our Picks Start at $9
 Score leggings, belt bags and more gift-worthy finds. Nov. 19, 2026, 9:52 AM EST Erica Marrison
 Associate Editor
 Vivian Le / TODAY Share Add TODAY to Google It’s rare for Lululemon to get in on holiday sales, but this year, the brand is kicking things off early with a Black Friday Sale featuring impressive savings on select products.
 The sale just dropped and includes an array of Lululemon’s signature styles, must-have accessories and seasonal layering staples. From trendy cropped Align leggings and the cult-favorite Everywhere Belt Bag to the brand’s iconic Define Jacket and budget-friendly stocking stuffers (think: socks, hair ties and other small accessories) we rounded up the best sale picks on offer — and every one comes in under $100. 
 We scoured Lululemon’s Black Friday Sale section to find the best buys worth adding to your cart. Shop our top picks below, but don’t wait too long — these deals are likely to go fast!
 Lululemon Black Friday Sale
 Lululemon Everywhere Belt Bag 
 $ 19.00 $ 38.00 Lululemon Now 50% off What to know Made to move with you from errand to errand, this compact and adjustable belt bag is designed to carry all of your essentials. 
 Colors: 11  | Materials: Recycled nylon, recycled polyester  | Dimensions: 7.5 x 2 x 5 in.  | Care: Spot clean Lululemon’s Everywhere Belt Bag is not only a viral hit with more than 20,000 five-star reviews, but it’s also editor approved for travel, dog walks, the gym and more. It features an adjustable strap so you can customize the fit, as well as a surprisingly spacious interior that makes it easy to take your essential items on the go.
 Lululemon Align High-Rise Crop Leggings (23 Inch) 
 $ 59.00 $ 98.00 Lululemon Now 40% off What to know These buttery-soft, high-rise crops offer breathable four-way stretch and a weightless feel, per the brand.
 Colors: 19  | Sizes: 0–20  | Materials: Nylon, lycra elastane  | Inseam: 23 in  | Care: Machine wash cold with like colors Lululemon’s Align leggings are another brand classic and right now, this copped pair is on sale. As suitable for casual daily wear as they are for yoga, you can wear them wherever, whenever. And they make a great gift, too.
 Lululemon Logo Bead Hair Ties (3 Pack) 
 $ 9.00 $ 20.00 Lululemon Now 55% off What to know These hair ties feature a small logo charm for added shine and flare.
 Colors: 4  | Count: 3  | Materials: Brass, elastane, polyester Looking for unique stocking stuffers? These beaded hair ties offer an elevated take on a daily essential. They’ll look as nice on your wrist as they do holding your ponytail in place, too.
 BETA Your shortcut to editor approved picks
 Lululemon Unisex Power Stride Crew Socks 
 $ 9.00 $ 18.00 Lululemon Now 50% off What to know These striped performance socks combine targeted cushioning and 360-degree arch support for a secure, comfortable fit.
 Sizes: S–XL  | Colors: 8  | Materials: Nylon, elastane Currently just $9, now’s the time to try Lululemon’s crew socks. Not only are they stylish, they feature 360-degree arch support to ensure a secure hold while you’re on the move, per the brand.
 Lululemon Dual Pouch Wristlet 
 $ 24.00 $ 48.00 Lululemon Now 50% off What to know Attached by a wrist loop, these two pouches keep your cards, keys and cash safe. You can wear them together or separately.
 Colors: 15  | Materials: Recycled nylon, recycled polyester This editor-approved wristlet comes with two pouches, which can hold your cards, keys and other mini must-haves. Since the pouches are detachable, you can carry them on the wristlet or solo.
 Lululemon All Yours Organic Cotton-Blend T-Shirt 
 $ 29.00 $ 48.00 Lululemon Now 40% off What to know This organic cotton tee features four-way stretch and is naturally breathable, per the brand. 
 Colors: 9  | Sizes: XXXS–XL  | Materials: Organic cotton, lycra elastane  | Care: Machine wash cold with like colors Up your T-shirt game with this timeless option, which boasts four-way stretch and is made from a breathable organic cotton blend, per the brand. 
 Lululemon Love Long-Sleeve Shirt 
 $ 39.00 $ 58.00 Lululemon Now 33% off What to know This simple long-sleeve shirt is easy to style, providing long-lasting comfort throughout the day. 
 Colors: 9  | Sizes: 0–14  | Materials: Pima cotton, lycra elastane  | Care: Machine wash cold with like colors Made with organic cotton jersey, this long-sleeve shirt is soft, breathable and flatters the body by falling loosely at the midsection. Plus, added lycra ensures that it holds its shape over time, per the brand.
 Lululemon Align Waist-Length Racerback Tank Top 
 $ 39.00 $ 58.00 Lululemon Now 33% off What to know Designed for yoga, this tank top features the brand's Nulu fabric, making it breathable, moisture-wicking and weightless. 
 Colors: 21  | Sizes: 0-20  | Material: Nylon, lycra elastane  | Care: Machine wash cold with like colors This moisture-wicking tank top works well for workouts and casual, everyday wear.
 Lululemon Pace Breaker Linerless Short (7 Inch) 
 $ 49.00 $ 68.00 Lululemon Now 28% off What to know Designed for performance, these men's shorts are lightweight and modern. 
 Colors: 45  | Sizes: XS-XXL  | Materials: Recycled polyester, elastane, lycra elastane  | Care: Machine wash cold with like colors  | Inseam: 7 in Whether you’re working out or hanging out, consider these comfortable shorts. Since they don’t have a liner, they have a streamlined fit that offers breathing room. With a seven-inch inseam, they’re not too short, not too long. 
 Lululemon Wunder Train High-Rise Tight (28 Inch) 
 $ 59.00 $ 98.00 Lululemon Now 40% off What to know Designed with Lululemon's own Everlux™ fabric, these leggings are wicking and will keep you cool throughout your workout.
 Colors: 18  | Sizes: 0-20  | Materials: Nylon, lycra elastane  | Care: Machine wash cold with like colors  | Inseam: 28 in Everyone needs a pair of black leggings and now’s the time to stock up! According to the brand, this pair is sweat-wicking, supportive and is made from four-way stretch material. There’s even a discreet pocket at the waist that’s great for carrying cards, keys or cash.
 Lululemon Hold Tight Long-Sleeve Shirt 
 $ 49.00 $ 68.00 Lululemon Now 28% off What to know A shirt designed for casual wear and comfort with soft, ribbed fabric and breathability. 
 Colors: 22  | Sizes: 0-20  | Materials: Lenzing modal, elastane  | Care: Machine wash cold with like colors With a soft, ribbed texture and four-way stretch, this long-sleeve top can be worn solo or as a winter base layer.
 Lululemon Steady State SuperLoft Funnel-Neck Half Zip 
 $ 69.00 $ 108.00 Lululemon Now 36% off What to know Made with Lululemon's SuperLoft fabric, this cozy half zip is a great layer for a trip to the gym or daily errands.
 Colors: 8  | Sizes: XXS-XL  | Materials: Cotton, recycled polyester, elastane  | Care: Machine wash cold with like colors With a popular funnel neck, this sweatshirt is of-the-moment yet classic. According to the brand, it features a brushed fleece interior, making it especially suitable for the fall and winter months. Note: It’s oversized, so the brand recommends sizing down if you prefer a more snug fit.
 Lululemon Define Jacket Nulu 
 $ 94.00 $ 138.00 Lululemon Now 32% off What to know Customers love this jacket for its flattering fit and wide range of color options.
 Colors: 25  | Sizes: 0-14  | Materials: Recycled polyester, elastane, nylon, lycra elastane  | Care: Machine wash cold with like colors Perfect for running errands and running sprints alike, this sporty jacket is a longtime staple from Lululemon. It’s figure-flattering, features comfortable thumb holes that keep the sleeves in place and has a “zipper garage” at the top of the collar to keep the zip from aggravating your chin, per the brand.
 How we chose Lululemon Black Friday Sale picks
 The Shop TODAY editors and writers search the internet to find the best products and sales out there. We research products, interview experts and use our own personal experiences to curate our recommendations and make shopping easier for our readers.
 For paid content, the Shop TODAY editorial team independently chooses products to recommend that are sold by the retailer (in this case, Lululemon). The retailer does not review or approve the content. Learn more about Shop TODAY .
 How do you add Shop TODAY as a Preferred Source on Google?
 Google’s new Preferred Sources feature allows users to manually select their favorite publishers and news outlets for a more customizable experience tailored directly to the reader. Once you’ve opted to receive our content, you’ll begin seeing more of our recent and trending articles displayed within your Top Stories news feed.
 The easiest way to add us as a preferred source is to click here and type in “ TODAY.com .” Once the box is checked and you’ve refreshed the page, Shop TODAY content will start appearing in your feed.
